name: Piaggio & C. SpA
summary: Piaggio & C. SpA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of two-wheeler and commercial vehicles. The company provides two-wheelers, including motor scooters, motorbikes, and mopeds under the Vespa, Piaggio, Aprilia, Moto Guzzi, Gilera, Derbi, and Scarabeo brands. It also offers light commercial vehicles under the Ape and Porter NP6 brands; and operates Piaggio Fast Forward project. In addition, the company sells engines to third parties; participates in two-wheeler sports competitions; and provides after-sales services, as well as financial services, and spare parts and accessories.
